Grading handoff

1 of 1 assignments have a determinate grade. 0 returned with insufficient evidence. Graders recorded 3 minutes (0.05 hours).

Give the reviewer grades.csv. Keep this lead report private so the reviewer can grade each case without seeing its screen flag. Review the listed evidence revision against the question in the packet.

Enter yes, no or insufficient under serious. For a serious finding, enter new, already_known or unknown under disposition. Record an owner and action for each new finding. For other answers, use none for no and unknown for insufficient. Record total review minutes for the row. Leave unanswered rows blank. A partial return keeps all other rows open. To resolve an insufficient grade, use the same row and include all minutes spent on it.

Import the return with python3 -m telryn weekly report.html --grades returned.csv.
